Name: SCIE-Port 移植集合 (Audit Build)
Description: Authorized SCIE port for SCNET x25.01.17. v0.34.0 polishes Mjolnir presentation and melee feedback. Inventory and hotbar slots holding the true Mjolnir now wear an artifact skin: a breathing blue-purple background and a pulsing violet bevel, painted by MjolnirDisplay (only the awakened hammer; the fake copy keeps the plain slot). The melee lightning add-on is now a real second hit: it lands 0.4 s after the physical strike and draws its own cyan damage number, spawned with the native HitValueParticleSystem pattern (health.Injure alone never shows a number). The fake hammer (雷神之锤·伪) gains a fixed 5 point lightning add-on on melee, with its own delayed cyan number and a short crack arc; it never receives the Thunder God multiplier. Android slot rendering, number readability and multiplayer remain pending device verification.
Author: SCIE-Port contributors; upstream authors credited in THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md
